goals.1: The difference between Aktiv and Passiv
grammar.0.note: Passiv = the action matters, not who does it. The Akkusativ object becomes the Nominativ subject. werden is the conjugated form (wird/werden), Partizip II at the end.
grammar.1.note: Subordinate clause: „…, dass die Straße repariert wird.“ (werden at the end). To say who does it: „von + Dativ“ — „Die Straße wird von der Stadt repariert“.

grammar.2.rows.5.1: on TV / on the radio / on the internet

quiz.9.prompt: Put the sentence in order: “The news is broadcast at eight o'clock.”
quiz.9.why: werden in second place, the Partizip at the end.
